# Ecliptic Launcher · Beta 6

Eclipse becomes **Ecliptic Launcher**, with the new planet mark, refreshed account experience and improvements throughout the launcher.

## New and improved

- Ecliptic branding across the launcher, Windows installer, updater and uninstaller, with public links to **eclipticmc.online**.
- A smoother player-selection carousel, clearer account controls and the new Ecliptic Account mark.
- Per-instance **Compatibility mode** in New Installation, Edit instance and Launch configuration. Enable it to skip both Skinlib and Ecliptic cosmetics on that instance’s next launch; other installations keep their own settings.
- Partner-server cards now show server details and a **Click to join** hint. Clicking opens an installation picker grouped by supported Minecraft versions, including your installed loader variants. **Download & join** prepares the newest supported stable vanilla release when it is missing.
- Improved modpack installation controls, version selection and Library presentation.
- Refined Java and memory settings, JVM presets, appearance controls and frosted-glass surfaces.
- Page-specific loading placeholders, faster installation reads in Addons, and server/world artwork in wellbeing history.
- **Save launcher logs** in About, with timestamped text files saved under the launcher’s data folder.
- Updated skin, animated-cape and badge previews, plus staff laptop connection support for authorised control-room accounts.

## Fixes

- Compatibility mode prevents appearance-agent preparation and injection across Java versions.
- Partner-server joining uses the instance you choose, rather than whichever installation was selected on Home. Latest Release is pinned to a supported version for that join.
- Corrected the Settings selection indicator and Ecliptic mark rendering while searching.
- Removed the unwanted glass tint behind the Normal cape label and cleaned up partner-server tooltips.
- Launcher child processes run without opening command windows, including server and tunnel helpers.
- Retained incremental app updates, existing runtime reuse and the full-download fallback from Beta 5.
- Existing beta shortcuts and older update helpers can open the renamed application through its compatibility entry point.

## Before testing

This is a Windows x64 beta. Test both a fresh installation and an upgrade from Beta 5, especially account persistence, installed games, shortcuts and updating. Back up important worlds before testing beta software.

Use **Ecliptic-Setup.exe** for installation. Component ZIPs are updater payloads, not source-code downloads. Older beta installations may still use Eclipse names for storage and compatibility; the updater preserves their data.

Partner compatibility follows the server’s advertised versions. Servers with custom required modpacks may still need the appropriate pack. Compatibility mode also disables launcher-provided appearance features for that instance until you switch it off again.
